title: Local gradient neural operator
abstract: arXiv:2609.07752v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Field temporal prediction and source identification constitute canonical problems in dynamical systems. Conventional approaches to these problems depend on a thorough understanding of the governing partial differential equations (PDEs). Recently, deep learning, as represented by neural operators, has provided a data-driven paradigm for addressing such tasks. However, most existing global neural operators for PDEs require large training datasets and many learnable parameters, with limited interpretability and generalization. We propose the local gradient neural operator (LGNO) as a lightweight and interpretable alternative for field temporal evolution prediction and source identification in typical mechanical problems. The method builds on priors from nonlinear gradient discretization and uses multilayer perceptron convolutional layers to learn translation-invariant local kernels that resemble discrete stencils. A zero consistent stencil

translated_abstract: 场的时间演化预测与源识别是动力系统中的经典问题。解决这些问题的传统方法依赖于对控制偏微分方程（PDE）的透彻理解。近年来，以神经算子为代表的深度学习为处理此类任务提供了一种数据驱动的范式。然而，现有的面向PDE的全局神经算子大多需要大量训练数据和众多可学习参数，且可解释性与泛化能力有限。我们提出局部梯度神经算子（LGNO），作为解决典型力学问题中场时间演化预测与源识别的轻量级、可解释的替代方案。该方法建立在非线性梯度离散化的先验知识基础上，利用多层感知机卷积层学习平移不变的局部核，这些局部核类似于离散模板。一个零一致模板……
tldr: 提出局部梯度神经算子（LGNO），一种基于非线性梯度离散化先验的轻量级、可解释的神经算子，可高效解决力学问题中的场时间演化预测与源识别任务。
en_tdlr: Proposed the local gradient neural operator (LGNO), a lightweight and interpretable neural operator built on nonlinear gradient discretization priors for efficient field evolution prediction and source identification in mechanical problems.
